item.title: Trump Campaigns for Darline Graham in South Carolina Runoff
item.description: President Donald Trump on Friday rallied supporters to back Sen. Darline Graham's bid for a full term, calling it a crucial step.

item.title: Newsom Encourages Californians to Use Trump Accounts
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom, a frequent critic of President Trump, urged families on Friday to take advantage of the accounts.

item.title: Ending Temporary Status Restores Order and Prioritizes Americans
Trump to Honor Artemis II Crew with Space Medal of Honor
item.description: President Trump will present the Congressional Space Medal of Honor to the Artemis II astronauts at NASA's Johnson Space Center on Aug. 28.
